This tutorial collects the mathematics behind
[Fundamentals of Machine Learning](../fundamentals-of-machine-learning/index.qmd). It covers notation, linear algebra, probability and statistics,
optimization and information theory, followed by the technical lemmas and inequalities that the learning theory proofs
use.

Each chapter sets out definitions and results, works through examples, and gives exercises to try. Chapters of the
machine learning tutorial link here when they need a result.

## Chapters

- [Notation](notation/index.qmd)
- [Mathematical and statistical foundations](mathematical-and-statistical-foundations/index.qmd)
- [Matrix factorizations and linear systems](matrix-factorizations-and-linear-systems/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Vector calculus and automatic differentiation](vector-calculus-and-automatic-differentiation/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Continuous random variables and exponential families](continuous-random-variables-and-exponential-families/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Statistical inference and limit theorems](statistical-inference-and-limit-theorems/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Gradient-based optimization methods](gradient-based-optimization-methods/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Constrained optimization and duality](constrained-optimization-and-duality/index.qmd) [In preparation]{.chapter-badge}
- [Appendices and technical background](appendices-and-technical-background/index.qmd)
:::
